questions.prompt: What renders when `count` is `0`?
questions.explanation: `0 && "Ready"` evaluates to `0`, which JSX renders as text.

questions.prompt: Why must React component names begin with an uppercase letter?
options: JSX compiles lowercase tags as built-in HTML strings rather than custom components
questions.explanation: Lowercase JSX tags compile to HTML tag strings like `"div"` instead of component references.

questions.prompt: How should a child component update data passed down through props?
options: Call an event callback prop provided by the parent that updates parent state
questions.explanation: Unidirectional data flow sends data down as props and change requests up via callbacks.

questions.prompt: What value does `count` hold after one click starting from `5`?

codeSnippet.code: const bump = () => { setCount((c) => c + 1); setCount((c) => c + 1); };

questions.explanation: Functional updaters queue sequentially (5 -> 6 -> 7) inside one batched render.

questions.prompt: Starting from `n = 0`, what is `n` after calling `setN(n + 1); setN(n + 1);` in one click?
questions.explanation: Both calls read the same snapshot (`0 + 1`); use `setN((x) => x + 1)` to reach 2.

questions.prompt: Why does `arr.push(5); setArr(arr);` not update the rendered list?
options: `Object.is(prevArr, arr)` is true because the array reference did not change
State arrays are frozen by JS
questions.explanation: Create a new array reference (`[...prev, 5]`) so React detects the state change.

questions.prompt: When `id` changes from `1` to `2`, what logs first?
questions.explanation: React always runs the previous effect’s cleanup before running the new effect.

questions.prompt: Which scenario legitimately requires `useEffect`?
options: Subscribing to a global `keydown` listener or mounting an external editor instance
questions.explanation: useEffect bridges React to external browser or third-party systems.

questions.prompt: Why can’t the callback passed directly to `useEffect` be marked `async`?
options: It returns a Promise instead of `void` or a synchronous cleanup function
questions.explanation: useEffect expects either undefined or a cleanup function, never a Promise.

questions.prompt: Why does `<Ctx.Provider value={{ theme, toggle }}>` re-render consumers when its parent re-renders even if `theme` didn’t change?
options: Inline object literal creates a brand-new reference every render
questions.explanation: Wrap `{ theme, toggle }` in `useMemo(..., [theme])` so reference identity stays stable.

questions.prompt: What happens to consumers of `AppContext` when `<AppContext.Provider value={{ user, theme }}>` gets a new object reference?
options: All consumers re-render even if they only read `user` and only `theme` changed
questions.explanation: Context notifies every subscriber whenever `Object.is(prevValue, nextValue)` is false.

questions.prompt: What stability guarantee does React provide for `dispatch` from `useReducer`?
options: Its function reference stays permanently identical across every render
It runs in a Web Worker
questions.explanation: Stable `dispatch` identity avoids invalidating `React.memo` and effect dependency arrays.

questions.prompt: Why does `<Child opts={{ a: 1 }} />` still re-render when `Child` is wrapped in `React.memo`?

const Child = memo(({ opts }: { opts: { a: number } }) =>

questions.prompt: What happens if you declare `function Inner() { ... }` inside `function Outer() { ... }`?
options: Inner gets a new identity every Outer render, causing React to unmount and remount it each time
questions.explanation: Reconciliation compares component references (`Prev !== Next`), unmounting and remounting on mismatch.

questions.prompt: When does `useCallback(fn, [])` actually stop a child component from re-rendering?
options: When the child is wrapped in `React.memo` (and all other props are referentially stable)
questions.explanation: Without `React.memo`, children re-render when parents re-render regardless of prop stability.

questions.prompt: In React 19, how does a custom `<Field />` component accept a `ref`?

codeSnippet.code: function Field({ ref, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'input'>) { return <input ref={ref} {...props} />; }

options: Directly as a normal prop (`ref`) without `forwardRef`
questions.explanation: React 19 passes `ref` directly as a standard component prop.

questions.prompt: Why should you NOT wrap a controlled `<input>`’s `setValue(e.target.value)` inside `startTransition`?
options: Typing updates must remain urgent/synchronous so input feedback and cursor position never lag
questions.explanation: Keep input text urgent and defer expensive downstream list rendering.

questions.prompt: Where must `useFormStatus()` be called to read `pending`?
options: Inside a child component rendered within the `<form>`
questions.explanation: `useFormStatus` subscribes to its nearest ancestor `<form>`.

questions.prompt: In what order do these log on mount?
questions.explanation: Render runs first (R), then useLayoutEffect before paint (L), then useEffect after paint (E).

questions.prompt: What happens when a user clicks `<button onClick={onCancel}>Cancel</button>` inside `<form onSubmit={onSave}>`?
options: Both `onCancel` AND `onSave` fire because `<button>` defaults to `type="submit"`
questions.explanation: Always add `type="button"` to non-submit buttons inside forms.

questions.prompt: Why should you profile React rendering bottlenecks in a production build rather than dev mode?
options: Dev mode adds StrictMode double-renders and runtime debug checks that skew timing dramatically
questions.explanation: Production builds strip dev checks and double-renders, showing true user-facing frame costs.

questions.prompt: Four independent JSON files each take 100ms to load. How long do they take sequentially vs with `Promise.all`?
questions.explanation: `Promise.all` fires all 4 independent requests concurrently so total latency matches the slowest single request.
